galatians.4.p1.b1.text: What I am saying is that as long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a slave, although he is the owner of everything.

galatians.4.p1.b2.text: He is subject to guardians and trustees until the date set by his father.

galatians.4.p1.b3.text: So also, when we were children, we were enslaved under the basic principles of the world.

galatians.4.p2.b1.text: But when the time had fully come, God sent His Son, born of a woman, born under the law,

galatians.4.p2.b2.text: to redeem those under the law, that we might receive our adoption as sons.

galatians.4.p2.b3.text: … God sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, crying out, “Abba, Father!”

galatians.4.p2.b4.text: So you are no longer a slave, but a son;

galatians.4.p3.b1.text: Formerly, when you did not know God, you were slaves to those who by nature are not gods.

galatians.4.p3.b2.text: … how is it that you are turning back to those weak and worthless principles? Do you wish to be enslaved by them all over again?

galatians.4.p3.b3.text: I fear for you, that my efforts for you may have been in vain.

galatians.4.p4.b1.text: I beg you, brothers, become like me, for I became like you.

galatians.4.p4.b2.text: You know that it was because of an illness that I first preached the gospel to you.

galatians.4.p4.b3.text: … you welcomed me as if I were an angel of God, as if I were Christ Jesus Himself.

galatians.4.p4.b4.text: Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?

galatians.4.p5.b1.text: Those people are zealous for you, but not in a good way. Instead, they want to isolate you from us, so that you may be zealous for them.

galatians.4.p5.b2.text: My children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in you,

galatians.4.p5.b3.text: how I wish I could be with you now and change my tone, because I am perplexed about you.

galatians.4.p6.b1.text: Tell me, you who want to be under the law, do you not understand what the law says?

galatians.4.p6.b2.text: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.

galatians.4.p6.b3.text: His son by the slave woman was born according to the flesh,

galatians.4.p6.b4.text: but his son by the free woman was born through the promise.
